description:
Application under section 96A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) for non-material amendments to planning permission reference 24/0176/FULOPDC dated 01/07/2025, for 'Change of use of the existing building from office (Class E) to a hotel (Class C1) with ground floor ancillary uses, change of use of the basement to a self-storage use (Class B8) with associated car parking, bicycle pavilion, landscaping, external alterations to the building, installation of a pergola at the southern entrance of the building and associated works.' 

Amendments comprise: amendment to application site boundary to incorporate adjoining land to the northeast of the site; reduction in number of hotel rooms; changes to layouts and floorspace for both the hotel and self-storage uses (including omission of atrium stair and redundant escape stair, and retention of existing basement ramp); reconfigured self-storage car parking arrangements; changes to elevations; revised design of entrance canopy; revised design and siting of bicycle pavilion; revised landscaping provisions; and other associated changes.
